subject: Difference in d.f. when fitting a mediator model in Mplus and lavaan

messages.author: 34a9c9f9b32618e3
messages.subject: Difference in d.f. when fitting a mediator model in Mplus and lavaan
parts:
Hi all,

I get different degrees of freedom (and results) when fitting a mediator model (6 exogenous variables measured by 1 or 2 manifest items each, 2 mediators defined by 1 or 2 (other) manifest items respectively, 1 endogenous variable defined by 1 (additional/other)  item).
I did specify the mediators to covary in lavaan and specified all indirect and direct paths.

Is there anything else I could possibly have forgotten to specify when converting a model from Mplus to lavaan? Something that Mplus does automatically, but lavaan does not?
Do you have any suggestions how to check?

Thanks!

Regards,
Svenja

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Difference in d.f. when fitting a mediator model in Mplus and lavaan
parts:
use lavInspect(fit) in lavaan to see which parameters were free; compare
this to the TECH1 output of Mplus.

Yves.
